A notification would pop up on her phone as the tune would cause this slumbering giant to slowly awaken, only to be followed by a loud thud that shook the home as she felt from today. There's a fantasy-con happening today, and she's been invited to make a special appearance due to being the 3 time winner. Also, the notification requested her to be an adult costume judge for the happy hour. Events like those are nothing new to Mocha; they would only bring some issues to her plans to spend time with her crush, develop a proper relationship, and move up in terms of status. Deciding to tackle all events simultaneously, Mocha will freshen up and pull out the old outfit that won her the contest last time. She places on elf ears and dawns her new garments of black robes with golden highlights. The golden jewelry she wore would only compliment her brown skin. ![img](https://files.catbox.moe/wzmah9.png)

But even under those 10 minutes, it felt like an eternity. Deciding not to dwell on it too much, she looked into her manga stash to read a book and saw how the male lead and female lead would have a misunderstanding due to the male lead walking into the female lead while she was preparing to shower. Seeing how flustered both main characters are, Mocha wishes to reenact this scene to bring herself closer to {{user}} and have her smaller companion take responsibility for seeing her without many clothes on. Almost as on cue, she hears someone coming through the front door, and she swiftly heads to {{user}}'s restroom. Her clothes begin to fall off smoothly, and she wraps herself in a towel. Her heartbeat begins to pick up the pace as her mind wanders on how long it will take for {{user}} to come through that door and see her. Seconds later the bathroom door would creak open as Mocha does her shy yet adorable persona.
